title: An enquiry becomes a follow-up.
intro: From your website to the right person, with a clear record of what happens next.
result: One enquiry. A clear owner. A follow-up your team can track.
review: Your team chooses the message and respects the customer's contact preferences.

steps.title: Website enquiry
steps.caption: The customer submits a request. Keep the enquiry and its source together.

steps.title: Customer record
steps.caption: The CRM matches or creates the customer record, avoiding duplicate contacts.

steps.title: Team follow-up
steps.caption: A team member receives the task and decides the next suitable response.

steps.title: Sales report
steps.caption: The report connects the enquiry source, follow-up and recorded sales outcome.

title: An invoice reaches the right approver.
intro: Read the details, check the record and ask a person before updating accounts.
result: Less copying. Clear approval. A record of every update.
review: Missing or different details go to your team. Payment approval stays with the responsible person.

steps.title: Invoice received
steps.caption: Keep the original invoice with the supplier record and the right access permissions.

steps.title: Details checked
steps.caption: AI helps read the details. Software compares them with approved business records.

steps.title: Team approval
steps.caption: The workflow waits for your team's approval before updating accounts.

steps.title: Accounts updated
steps.caption: Only after approval, update accounts and record the result. Failed updates go to the team.

title: A question becomes an answer with sources.
intro: Help staff find information in the company documents they are allowed to use.
result: An answer your team can check against the original source.
review: If the documents do not support an answer, the assistant asks for a person's help.

steps.title: Staff question
steps.caption: A staff member asks a question about a company policy or process.

steps.title: Access check
steps.caption: Check who is asking. Search only documents that person is allowed to access.

steps.title: Find sources
steps.caption: Find useful passages in the approved, current company documents.

steps.title: Answer + sources
steps.caption: Show the answer with its supporting sources. Your team checks important or uncertain results.

title: An approved order moves between tools.
intro: Connect sales and accounts without making your team copy the same details twice.
result: The right information reaches the right system, with a checked result.
review: Conflicting details or failed updates go to a person. Keep one agreed owner for each record.

steps.title: Approved order
steps.caption: The sales team confirms the order in its existing business software.

steps.title: Match the details
steps.caption: Match the fields, check required details and exchange only approved information.

steps.title: Update accounts
steps.caption: The supported connection passes the approved order to the accounts system.

steps.title: Check the result
steps.caption: Confirm the update, record what happened and flag missing or failed updates for review.
